scope: Maintained local fake-provider regression. No real GCP lifecycle, application cold readiness, retained-data growth, cost acceptance or shipment claim.
rootCause: The Bash benchmark captured lifecycle exit codes only for logging, then continued. Restarting a maxRunDuration VM resets its relative lifetime; no absolute-deadline conservation was checked. The old fake provider covered create and SSH failure only.

observations: Stop failure 17 continued to set/start and DONE with exit 0.
Set-machine-type failure 19 continued to start and DONE with exit 0.
Start failure 23 continued to SSH instead of aborting immediately.

fix: Abort immediately on failed stop, set-machine-type, set-scheduling or start.
Read provider JSON before measurement; require a future DELETE schedule.
Convert relative creation-time lifetime conservatively to its original absolute bound while stopped; clear maxRunDuration.
Read provider JSON before and after start; require exact original absolute deadline, DELETE, expected status and target machine type.
Propagate unsuccessful teardown; emit DONE only after successful measurement and cleanup.

coverage: Positive relative and absolute deadline preservation across restart.
Immediate stop/set/scheduling/start failure propagation with teardown.
Missing, expired, non-DELETE and malformed initial schedules.
Unchanged relative, extended, expired or STOP readback before start.
Deadline drift after start before downstream SSH.
Provider describe failure and invalid JSON.
Teardown failure and primary failure preservation.

providerSemantics.source: Installed gcloud compute instances set-scheduling --help, read 2026-10-17
observations: maxRunDuration is relative to the last RUNNING transition.
terminationTime stays fixed across reruns; expired timestamps refuse restart.
clear-max-run-duration and termination-time are independently supported flags.

remainingAcceptance: D-075 real candidate capacity and cold application readiness.
D-076 actual all-category monthly billed cost under $20.
P-537 authenticated product journey, source-to-serving parity and final shipment.
